scope: Personal project; retain current official Node base, no zero-CVE or alternate-base requirement.
policy: A successful scan is mandatory. Findings remain visible and are not labelled fixed. Fixable HIGH/CRITICAL findings block; upstream findings without a fix are accepted as an observed residual risk unless application impact is confirmed. Add confirmed-impact IDs to blockingIds regardless of fix availability.
reviewTrigger: Review each dependency/base update and before public deployment; reassess unfixed findings when a fix or credible application exploit appears.
